title: Preview Pane: handle WebView2 initialization failures in Markdown/Monaco handlers

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the new WebView2 regression timeout wrap-safe

**Severity:** `medium`

The new regression test can skip its message-pump loop near signed `Environment.TickCount` overflow: adding the 60-second timeout produces a negative deadline even though initialization has not completed. Use the 64-bit clock and compare elapsed time so this test observes the WebView2 failure reliably at those system uptimes.

```suggestion
                    long beforeTick = Environment.TickCount64;

                    while (markdownPreviewHandlerControl.Controls.Count == 0 && unhandledException == null && Environment.TickCount64 - beforeTick < HardTimeoutInMilliseconds)
```
proposed_comments.title: Keep the new regression watchdog wrap-safe

confidence.rationale: Exact C# upstream guard skips the first pump at the signed deadline boundary; the literal guard passes 76 deterministic cases, and the complete affected test projects compile on both exact trees.
